*Note:* Each row compares estimates for the same fiscal year published in different documents (same-year prices, so the nominal comparison is meaningful). First projection = first projection year of the report whose realisation year is the preceding year. Budget-law estimate = the estimate attached to that year's central government budget law: taken from the budget-law annex for 2019 and 2020 (Official Gazette 30642 and 30995, Mükerrer) and otherwise from the budget-law table reprinted in the reports. The 2019 budget-law figure is identical to the 2018 report's projection (the 2018 report states that its amounts were also added to the budget law; one estimate, counted once). The 2020 budget-law figure appears in no report analysed; it is used only as the budget-law estimate for 2020. No first projection exists for 2019 because no 2019 report was found; the 2019 realisation estimate is from the 2020 report. 'Realisation' is the later report's ex post revenue-forgone estimate, not an observed outcome. Differences reflect macro assumptions, legal changes and data/method updates together; they are not a measure of policy effects.
